scenarios.name: Close an additional window without closing the part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the user creates a second window for the part through View New
the first window has an active sketch editing environment
the second window is active after switching from Home
the second window closes without a save prompt
the remaining part tab no longer has a window number
the user selects the remaining part tab
the original sketch viewport and model browser are displayed
the sketch editing environment remains active
